scope: Public v017 walkthrough, approved by the owner
limitations: Furniture opening disabled after reported instability. Static closed-furniture fallback; regression cause unconfirmed, not an interactive-storage fix. Stairs visual-only. Simplified materials; not construction approval. Rear OTS has provisional open metal grating at floor level with a shaft void below. Grating, supports, glass and roofing are not certified construction. Electronics are schematic proposals only. Washer is deferred by the user, not a batch blocker; no washer is modeled. Inverter/battery, AV receiver and outdoor AC units remain unplaced. No electrical or fire-safety certification. Existing-size aquarium on its own open frame; loaded floor/stand support and installation are not verified. Water/fish are illustrative. Glazed partition is a proposed wall alteration pending structural/site review. No tested AC/acoustic performance or electrical/thermal cabinet approval. Door is closable in the design but held open in the walkthrough. Front arched door/window assemblies follow user photos with source-plan widths; unmeasured elevations, frame/grille and glazing details are provisional. Exterior surroundings are not modeled. Three proposed ceiling overlays preserve source beams/daylight and show five fan provisions. Suspension, service/driver access, fan capacity, detector locations, board ratings and actual heights require professional/product verification.
